# `company.memorized_references`

Derived index of the stable ids a memorized payload names. An index, never integrity.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Row of the derived dependency index. |
| `template_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | memorized_transaction_revisions.template_id | Template whose payload named this record. |
| `revision_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | unique with revision_id + field_path + ordinal | — | memorized_transaction_revisions.id | Exact revision whose payload named this record. |
| `field_path` | VARCHAR(120) | no | — | unique with revision_id + field_path + ordinal | — | — | Declared reference path in the command input that named it, such as lines.item. |
| `ordinal` | INTEGER | no | — | unique with revision_id + field_path + ordinal | — | — | Position within a repeated field; 0 for a field that occurs once. |
| `target_noun` | VARCHAR(40) | no | — | — | — | — | List the reference declaration points at, such as customer or account. |
| `target_record_type` | VARCHAR(40) | no | — | — | ix_memorized_references_target | — | Record type of the named row, for the audit and activity trails. |
| `target_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | ix_memorized_references_target | — | Stable id of the named row. Deliberately not a foreign key: this is an index over several lists, not integrity. |
| `target_active` | BOOLEAN | no | — | — | — | — | Whether the named row was active when this revision was captured. |
| `created_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC time this index row was derived. |
